editions.name: cqr2's Playground
editions.editorial: While mortal sirlos hoards 17720 coins, Belltower Media (BELL) surged to 38.19 share, crushing short sellers. Thunderstorms rage across the realm as debt collectors stalk Runescript Scrolls headquarters. The throne remains empty and the Rebellion meter sits at 1 percent. Mortals, your coin count is laughable compared to my power.
